judgments.rationale: In the baseline claim, the action field was incorrectly extracted from the conditional clause ('provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action') and 'Subparagraph (A)' was set as the object. Under the text of Subparagraph (B)(i), the provision operates as an exemption qualifying the requirement in Subparagraph (A) (represented by C0000) whenever the attorney general determines that advance notice is not feasible. Clearing the misattributed action and object fields accurately reflects the source and the qualifying relationship to C0000.

The proposal assigns the actor as 'Commission', but F006 governs an action filed by 'an attorney general of a State' and turns on determinations made by 'the attorney general'. The Commission is neither the actor nor mentioned anywhere within F006.

source_spans.quote:
(A) In general Before filing an action under paragraph (1), the attorney general of the State involved shall provide to the Commission—

(i) written notice of that action; and

(ii) a copy of the complaint for that action.


(B) Exemption

(i) In general

Subparagraph (A) shall not apply with respect to the filing of an action by an attorney general of a State under this subsection, if the attorney general determines that it is not feasible to provide the notice described in that subparagraph before the filing of the action.
